title: Series
description: A list of numbers to chart, with a title and optional unit and position labels.

title.title: Title
title.description: What the numbers measure; the page heading.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: The unit of each value, shown in tooltips and the table. Leaving it out shows none.

values.title: Values
values.description: The numbers to chart, in drawing order.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: One name per value. Leaving it out numbers the positions from 1; if given it should have as many entries as values.
